title: Wrenfield portal sign-in flow
brief: Please write up for the IT help desk of Wrenfield University how a student gets signed in to the course portal, as a page they will read on laptops while taking calls, dated 2026-10-26. Section "Sign-in sequence": five parties, named exactly Student Browser, Course Portal, Identity Provider, Directory, Session Store. In order: Student Browser to Course Portal "open course list"; Course Portal to Student Browser "redirect to sign-in"; Student Browser to Identity Provider "password and authenticator code"; Identity Provider to Directory "check account and groups"; Directory to Identity Provider "active, groups: undergrad, library"; Identity Provider to Student Browser "signed token, valid 8 hours"; Student Browser to Course Portal "present token"; Course Portal to Identity Provider "verify token"; Identity Provider to Course Portal "token valid"; Course Portal to Session Store "create session, 30 minute idle limit"; Course Portal to Student Browser "course list". Section "Time limits" as a table: signed token, 8 hours; idle session, 30 minutes; authenticator code, 30 seconds; lockout after 5 wrong passwords, 15 minutes. Section "Common calls", three cases with what the help desk does: account locked after 5 wrong passwords, so wait 15 minutes or ask a supervisor to unlock it; student says the code is always wrong, so check the phone clock is set automatically; session ended mid-quiz, so the 30 minute idle limit applies and quiz timers keep running. Remind agents prominently that they must never ask a student to read out a password.

edit.request: Change the signed token validity from 8 hours to 12 hours, and add a last message after the course list: Student Browser to Course Portal "request first lesson".
